blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: South Village stands on 23A Avenue at 164 Street, south of 24 Avenue, inside the Sunnyside Heights plan area.

The Sunnyside Heights Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) area is bordered by 168 Street to the east, 24 Avenue to the north and the Highway 99 Corridor Plan to the west, with the protected Fergus Watershed Biodiversity Preserve to the south.
The plan area covers about 153 hectares (379 acres) and is the second neighbourhood plan area planned within Grandview Heights.

blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The municipal record for this site is an assembled four-parcel approval: 2348-164 Street plus 16437, 16457 and 16467-23 Avenue, rezoned to permit a 74-unit townhouse development.
Council approved that rezoning on July 22, 2013, changing the Official Community Plan (OCP) designation from Suburban to Urban at the same time.
The applicant named in the City minutes is 0966540 B.C. Ltd., care of Legendary Developments Ltd., not the builder name used in later marketing for the builder attribution.

blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: South Village's zone is Multiple Residential 30 (RM-30) under Surrey Zoning By-law, 1993, No. 12000, set by Amendment By-law, 2013, No. 18042, with the companion OCP amendment in By-law No. 18041.

The Sunnyside Heights land-use designations have been superseded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update, so a rebuild or addition question for this complex is answered from the OCP and the RM-30 zone, not the original NCP.

blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Edgewood Park, a City park at 2284-165 Street, is the neighbourhood park for this pocket, east of the complex.
Ta'talu Elementary at 1970 165A Street is a second, newer elementary school in the wider Sunnyside Heights pocket, recorded in the British Columbia school list for School District 36.
Council amended the Sunnyside Heights plan in December 2017, changing land uses in the south portion of the plan area, so two homes a few streets apart here can sit under different plan vintages.

The Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre at 16855-24 Avenue, with a 10-lane, 50-metre FINA-standard (International Swimming Federation standard) competition pool, is this pocket's recreation anchor at the top of 168 Street.

blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: getting around

items.t: TransLink route 531 runs from White Rock Centre to Willowbrook via 24 Avenue, which is the crosstown bus spine one avenue north of this complex.
TransLink route 354 runs via 160 Street and 24 Avenue to the South Surrey Park & Ride and Bridgeport Station, the Canada Line connection for this side of South Surrey.
Orchard Grove Park at 16685 24 Avenue sits on the same 24 Avenue corridor the 531 follows, per the City's park page.

blocks.text: South Village, Grandview Heights Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check any lot or strata parcel near the south edge against the Fergus Watershed Biodiversity Preserve boundary: the City names the preserve as the Sunnyside Heights plan boundary, and land beside a protected watershed can carry riparian and tree-protection conditions a listing will not state.

Read the depreciation report and minutes before subjects: strata corporations with five or more strata lots must obtain a depreciation report under British Columbia's strata framework, and disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

faq.q: The City approved 74 townhomes here, so why do listings describe a smaller complex?
faq.a: The 74-unit figure is the whole assembled site. City minutes for application 7913-0065-00 cover four parcels — 2348-164 Street and 16437, 16457 and 16467-23 Avenue — rezoned RA to RM-30 for a 74-unit townhouse development. A single strata phase at one civic address is only part of that approval, so compare a unit against its own strata plan, not the 74-unit site total.

faq.q: Which elementary school is within walking distance of South Village?
faq.a: Edgewood Elementary at 16666 23 Avenue is the elementary school in this pocket, a few blocks east on the same avenue system. The British Columbia school list records it in School District 36 (Surrey). Proximity is not catchment: confirm 16467 23A Avenue in the district school locator before writing an offer that depends on Edgewood.

faq.q: What is south of South Village if I keep walking?
faq.a: Protected watershed land, not more housing. The Sunnyside Heights plan area ends at the Fergus Watershed Biodiversity Preserve, which the City names as the plan's southern boundary. That preserve edge is why the streets in this pocket stop at the plan boundary instead of continuing south as a grid.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in South Village Grandview?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in South Village Grandview freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
